about: Files moved here byte for byte from another code tree by tools/move-code-between-trees: each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Only import paths and the listed calls differ.

files.adapted: The bytes here are not the bytes of its source: the receipt named bytes no commit of this checkout ever held, so it names the bytes the file has. The dependency on trillion-workshop (a tarball of an older commit of this Workshop) is left out: the file ships in the Workshop, which resolves its own name through the root devDependency "trillion-workshop": "file:.".
